key_findings.name: James Beveridge
key_findings.evidence: Name clearly written in the inhabitant list.
key_findings.identity_status: name-only; no confirmed link to a canonical person

key_findings.name: Thomas Beveridge
key_findings.evidence: Name clearly written in the inhabitant list.
key_findings.identity_status: name-only; this manuscript does not identify him as the later town clerk

key_findings.name: Matthew Beveridge
key_findings.evidence: Matthew Beveridge is followed by the handwritten phrase 'a minor'; beneath an underline is an additional marginal word that appears to read 'major'. The second hand, date and correction status are unverified.
key_findings.identity_status: name-only; age annotation disputed; no proved connection to the Matthew of Hope who died in 1837
key_findings.age_interpretation: Neither an age nor legally confirmed minority may be inferred from this conflicting notation until its sequence and meaning are independently established.

entry_note: 'Seventy two settlers before the first day of January 1784' is visible in the March 1786 original resolution; the 1889 Vinalhaven town history prints 'seventy-five settlers before ... January 1784' in its purported transcription of that same clause. This is a material textual discrepancy, not simply different populations.
limits: The list is reproduced in a manuscript petition; an individual entry is not itself proof that the person signed personally, occupied a particular lot, paid the grant assessment, or had any stated familial relationship.

leaves.label: Petition · leaf 1
leaves.description: The inhabitants' account of earlier settlement, wartime evacuation and losses at Bagaduce.
leaves.excerpt: That your Petitioners or their Ancestors did about Twenty Years since settle on the small Islands known by the Name of the Fox Islands …
leaves.confidence: selected reading; spelling/punctuation normalized for search
leaves.source_file: SC1 228 Passed Resolves 1785 ch97 petition p1(1).tif

leaves.label: Petition · leaf 2
leaves.description: Request for recognition of the settlers' claims and the opening of the names list.
leaves.excerpt: Your Petitioners are now peaceably resettled upon the said Islands … and also to found a Public School for the Education of their Children.
leaves.confidence: selected reading; manuscript orthography retained in part
leaves.source_file: SC1 228 Passed Resolves 1785 ch97 petition p2(1).tif

leaves.label: Petition · leaf 3
leaves.description: Two-column settler-name list, including James, Thomas and Matthew Beveridge; legislative endorsement dated June 1, 1785. The handwritten age annotation is ambiguous: 'a minor' is underlined and 'major' appears below; edition and timing unresolved.
leaves.excerpt: James Beveridge [left column]; Thomas Beveridge [right column]; Matthew Beveridge [right column]; 'a minor' underlined; below 'major' [?].
leaves.confidence: Names directly legible; adjacent age-status annotations conflict or may represent an amendment. Do not assign legal age.
leaves.source_file: SC1 228 Passed Resolves 1785 ch97 petition p3(1).tif

leaves.label: Petition · leaf 4 / endorsements
leaves.description: Committee endorsement and rotated docket annotations; several marginal notes require second paleographic reading.
leaves.excerpt: The Committee to whom was committed the aforesaid Petition have attended the Service assigned them & report the Resolve herewith presented.
leaves.confidence: selected reading of main note; docket not fully transcribed
leaves.source_file: SC1 228 Passed Resolves 1785 ch97 petition p4(1).tif

leaves.label: Resolve · leaf 1
leaves.description: Senate resolve dated March 11, 1786; reports 16,527 acres and 72 settlers before January 1, 1784; grant and reserved public acreage. The 1889 printed town history transcribes this very sentence as 'seventy-five' rather than manuscript 'seventy two'.
leaves.excerpt: … the said Islands contain in the whole sixteen thousand, five hundred and twenty seven acres … whereon were seventy two settlers before the first day of January 1784 …
leaves.confidence: selected reading of original; punctuation regularized
leaves.source_file: SC1 228 Passed Resolves 1785 ch97 resolve p1(1).tif

leaves.label: Resolve · leaf 2
leaves.description: Protection for bona fide purchasers of improvements and House approval dated March 13, 1786.
leaves.excerpt: … the purchaser of such improvements, his heirs and assigns shall hold the same lands which such original settler would have held by virtue of this Resolve …
leaves.source_file: SC1 228 Passed Resolves 1785 ch97 resolve p2(1).tif

leaves.label: Resolve · leaf 3 / docket
leaves.description: Exterior docket naming the Fox Islands settlers and legislative resolution; rotated text and endorsements remain to be transcribed.
leaves.excerpt: Petition of the Settlers on Fox Islands [docket — partial reading].
leaves.source_file: SC1 228 Passed Resolves 1785 ch97 resolve p3(1).tif

outstanding: Find the original March 18, 1786 Putnam settlers' declarations in paper Box 001, Maine State Archives; they have not been inspected.
Identify individually assigned lots, grantee deeds, or proprietors' books for James, Thomas, and Matthew.
Compare any discovered guardianship or probate for Matthew named a minor, without identifying him with the 1837 Hope decedent prematurely.
Publish the seven provided TIFFs or optimized derivatives in permanent site storage with provenance and archival permission review; this JSON does not contain or publish the scans.
Complete independent paleographic verification of all seven leaves and docket annotations.

Establish the handwriting sequence and intention of the paired 'a minor' / possible 'major' notes beside Matthew in petition leaf 3; check whether contemporary Senate/House folios, endorsements, or a second certified copy preserve a correction.
Compare the original 1786 resolve's 'seventy two' with the 1889 printed 'seventy-five' and any 1786 session laws, avoiding circular reliance on later reproductions.
